name: Marabou
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou.queries/ --network f:fake.onnx --loggingPass Solver

name: MarabouVerify
run: vehicle verify -s spec.vcl -v TestVerifier --network f:fake.onnx --property p --verifier-location=testVerifier --verifier-args='sat 'f_X[0]=0.2,f_X[1]=0.2,f_Y[0]=0.3,f_Y[1]=3.0'' --logging MaxDetail
